The company redacted the crash narrative and software version as “confidential business information.”

stories.title: Seven Drones, Five Drones, and Not One Confirmed: The Lakenheath Drone Panic
stories.summary: Suffolk Constabulary logs record unverified drone sightings over RAF Lakenheath, Mildenhall, and Feltwell in November 2024, with patrols unable to locate or identify the objects. The article notes that similar misidentifications of ordinary aircraft as drones occurred at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and Copenhagen Airport.

stories.title: Tech leaders say EV innovation, robotaxis key for Apec
stories.summary: CATL founder Robin Zeng and Baidu chief executive Robin Li told the Apec CEO Summit in Shenzhen that electric vehicle innovation and robotaxis are key for the Asia-Pacific region. Zeng highlighted battery swapping technology that allows cars to swap batteries in 99 seconds, while Li noted that robotaxis have a safety record about 10 times better than human drivers.

stories.title: Railway. Powered by Precision: ASC Brings German Sensor Technology to InnoRail India
stories.summary: ASC Sensors will exhibit high-precision inertial sensor solutions at InnoRail India 2026 in Lucknow from November 26-28. The company participates in the German Pavilion, supported by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy, to present technologies for railway safety and maintenance.

stories.title: Tesla may test customer-owned cars in its Robotaxi network as soon as December, Musk says
stories.summary: Elon Musk said on X that Tesla may start trials next month to put customer-owned cars into its Robotaxi network. Tesla has not published a program, specified which cars or cities would qualify, or explained how owners would share fares.

stories.title: Dream of the Desert ultra-luxury train to launch in October 2027
stories.summary: Arsenale International and Saudi Arabia Railways opened bookings for the Dream of the Desert, described as the world’s first ultra-luxury desert journey by train.

stories.title: Explosions heard in Bahrain after threat alert, Iran claims drone attack on US radar
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed a drone strike on a US-operated radar system at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain on Tuesday morning. Explosions were heard in Manama after residents received mobile-phone alerts warning of a potential threat.

stories.title: China’s railway investment rises 0.9% in first 10 months
SkyDrive Partners with Gold Coast to Advance eVTOL Deployment
stories.summary: SkyDrive signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the City of Gold Coast to explore eVTOL feasibility, following an August 2026 Letter of Intent with Gold Coast Helitours. The partnership aims to launch commercial operations in 2028 using five SD-05 aircraft, with vertiports planned near Gold Coast Airport and Marina Mirage.

stories.title: FBI – Seeking information, drone in restricted airspace
stories.summary: The FBI’s Field Office in Washington, D.C., is seeking information regarding individuals who allegedly flew a drone in restricted airspace near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport on or about October 29, 2026. The activity impacted airport operations and may violate federal laws punishable by fines, imprisonment for not more than one year, or both.

stories.title: Eurostar appoints Newrest to run onboard catering and lounges
stories.summary: Eurostar selected Newrest to operate onboard catering and lounge services across its network, including Eurostar Plus, Eurostar Premier, Eurostar Café, and five lounges in Brussels, London, and Paris.

stories.title: Interview: China's autonomous vehicle ecosystem favorable for foreign operators, says Singapore transport group CEO
stories.summary: ComfortDelGro Group Chief Executive Officer Cheng Siak Kian said China's regulatory environment and maturing autonomous vehicle industry create favorable conditions for foreign operators to test services. The Singapore-based group is establishing a regional autonomous mobility headquarters in Shenzhen to leverage local technology for deployment in other markets.

stories.title: Chinese Air Force Unveils Experimental Drone Firing Medicine Darts at Wounded Troops
stories.summary: China’s Air Force Medical University presented an experimental casualty-search drone that fires a dart to inject medicine into wounded personnel, CCTV reported. The system remains exploratory, with the drug, dose, range, and accuracy undisclosed, and the university noted that retrieving incapacitated personnel for evacuation remains unresolved.

stories.title: Yaskawa robotic welding boosts Tank Clinic production efficiency
stories.summary: Yaskawa Southern Africa developed a robotic welding system for Tank Clinic that reduced the time to weld an aluminium road tanker from approximately one week to an eight-hour working day. The installation, which combines a Yaskawa AR1440 robot with an OTG-XYZ gantry, is the first of its type in South Africa and one of four worldwide.

stories.title: Elroy Air Takes Up To $70M Order For 20 Chaparral Cargo Drones
stories.summary: Abu Dhabi’s Barq Group signed an aircraft purchase agreement with Elroy Air for up to 20 Chaparral autonomous cargo drones, a transaction valued at up to $70 million. The deal includes a $10.25 million deposit for five firm orders, with deliveries scheduled to begin in 2027.

stories.title: Houston's Counter-Drone Policy: Federal Rule Covers Jammers, Not Radar
Wing plans to expand drone delivery from Ponchatoula to New Orleans in the future
stories.summary: Wing began drone deliveries at the Ponchatoula Walmart, the first store in Louisiana to offer the service, using a fleet of more than a dozen drones to serve a six-mile radius. The Federal Aviation Administration granted Wing a Part 135 Air Carrier Certificate and permission for flights beyond the visual line of sight, and the company plans to expand services to New Orleans in the future.

stories.title: Trump Laughs Off Drone Attack Question From Reporter: 'I'm More Worried About You'
stories.summary: President Trump dismissed a reporter's question about Iranian drone threats by stating, “I’m more worried about you because if they get me, you’re gone, too.” Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin described the drone threats as “aspirational” but acknowledged that counter-unmanned aircraft systems remain a major concern with current technological limitations.

stories.title: Futuristic air taxis to begin test runs over Los Angeles ahead of Olympics: ‘Writing the blueprint’
stories.summary: Archer Aviation plans to begin testing its Midnight aircraft at Hawthorne Airport within weeks, aiming to launch a passenger service for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The company has been named the official air taxi provider by LA28, though initial flights will use a conventional runway and not carry passengers.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab involved in eight crashes in the US in two months — Electrek
stories.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) recorded eight crashes involving Tesla Cybercab vehicles in the US within two months of public rides beginning in Austin. Four driverless incidents occurred in Austin in August and September, while four other crashes involving driver-assistance systems happened in September 2026, including a 53 mph collision in Philadelphia.

also.title: Tesla's Cybercab has eight crashes on file with NHTSA two months into Austin rides

stories.title: DJI Matrice 30 Turns Up at New Orleans Rescue in a Skydio City
stories.summary: A DJI Matrice 30 with “POLICE” printed on its arms was at the Port of New Orleans after the tanker Atlantic Asphalt hit the docked river cruise ship American Heritage on Friday, Nov. 13. Louisiana freelance photographer Andrew Liang photographed the drone in the hands of a responder wearing an orange flotation vest, with yellow tape strung across the plaza behind him.

stories.title: Amazon's Nampa Drone Permit Names No Limit on Noise, Height or Flights
stories.summary: Nampa, Idaho, issued a conditional use permit for Amazon’s Prime Air drone hub that includes five conditions but sets no limits on drone noise, altitude, flight hours, or the number of flights. The permit requires Amazon to provide a local contact for complaints reachable within 72 hours, while the findings of fact state drones operate at a minimum of 200 feet and produce 53 to 55 dBA at 500 feet from the launch pad.

stories.title: New Controller Stops Collisions and Cuts Angular Jerk in Omnidirectional
stories.summary: Researchers introduced a CBF-critic-based, heading-aware Model Predictive Path Integral navigation architecture for omnidirectional mobile robots. The system achieved a 100 percent collision-free success rate and reduced maximum angular jerk by approximately 91.6 percent in parallel parking trials.

stories.title: Hyundai Motor Group Secures 100% Stake in Boston Dynamics... Speeds Up Robot Mass Production
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor Group completed the acquisition of SoftBank's remaining 9.65% stake in Boston Dynamics, securing 100% ownership. The group plans to establish mass-production capacity for 30,000 humanoid robots a year by 2028, with initial deployment at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America in Georgia.

stories.title: Agile Robots is betting on humanoid robots for practical applications.
stories.summary: German robotics company Agile Robots raised $500 million in a Series F round led by SoftBank Group, valuing the firm at $8.5 billion. The company plans to use the capital to expand U.S. operations, increase German production capacity, and develop new markets for its humanoid robots.

stories.title: Driver of car hit by Russian FPV drone dies in Zaporizhzhia - regional military administration
stories.summary: A Russian FPV drone struck a car in Zaporizhzhia’s Kosmichnyi district on Monday evening, killing the driver, according to Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration head Mykhailo Semikin.

stories.title: Simulation Shows Small Autonomous Electric Fleet Meets Montreal Olympic
stories.summary: Researchers Elena Golchin and Anjali Awasthi found that a fleet of twenty autonomous electric vehicles can meet Montreal Olympic Park demand with a ninety percent service rate. Their simulation of one hundred and five scenarios showed that reducing parking spaces per station decreases rejected customers by prompting automatic vehicle redistribution.

stories.title: Tesla rolls out X Money payments for Robotaxi with up to 3% cashback
stories.summary: Tesla added X Money as a payment option in its Robotaxi app, allowing riders to earn up to 3% cashback on trips. The service is currently available only in the United States, with no announced plans to launch in Canada.

stories.title: Tesla announces new Robotaxi services around Fort Worth
stories.summary: Tesla announced the launch of its Robotaxi and Cybercab services in Fort Worth on Nov. 2. According to Basenor.com, a 15-minute ride costs $16.99 in the Model Y and $9.65 in the Cybercab, which is cheaper than Uber's average $21 fare.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab Germany: $3.3B Grünheide Plan
stories.summary: Tesla plans to spend €3 billion, about $3.31 billion, on a new Cybercab production building at its Gigafactory in Grünheide, near Berlin. The company intends to file the building-permit application before the end of 2026, with construction due to start in the first half of 2027 and production in 2029.

stories.title: DoW evaluates counter-UAS and jamming capabilities at Fort Knox Nov. 3-5
stories.summary: The Defense Innovation OnRamp Hub: Kentucky partnered with V Corps from Nov. 3-5 to test emerging defense technologies against simulated threats at Fort Knox’s Yano Range. During three days of demonstrations, 15 commercial technology providers deployed systems designed for electromagnetic support and attack.

stories.title: Amid Questions About Workforce Development, Autonomous Vehicle Legislation Fails in Committee
‘Put the Brakes on Driverless Cars’ Campaign Takes Over AC During League
stories.summary: 32BJ SEIU and the App Drivers Union launched a campaign in Atlantic City urging New Jersey lawmakers to reject S1677 and A3968, bills that would allow fully autonomous vehicle rideshare networks after 100,000 test miles. The unions displayed billboards on the Atlantic City Expressway and digital ads at the Convention Center and Ocean Casino Resort during the State League of Municipalities’ 111th Annual Conference from November 17 through 19.

stories.title: DiDi advances Robotaxi technology, expands autonomous driving operations in China
stories.summary: DiDi advanced its autonomous driving operations in China by delivering the next-generation Robotaxi R2 in January 2026, which features a 33-sensor system and a central computing unit with more than 2,000 TOPS of GPU computing power. The company reported more than 2,200 consecutive days of safe operation in Beijing and Guangzhou, while its DiDi Care Fund has supported more than 5,500 driver families.

stories.title: Tesla's Cybercab sales to the public are 'early validation' of robotaxi push, JPMorgan says
stories.summary: Tesla began selling its driverless Cybercab to select customers for $29,990 plus a $299 monthly fee, with deliveries estimated for December in Texas. JPMorgan analyst Rajat Gupta called the launch early validation of Tesla's physical AI advantage, though he expects limited earnings contribution until 2028.

also.title: Tesla opens Cybercab orders with strict ownership rules

stories.title: Purdue drone research advances frontiers of autonomous aviation
stories.summary: A Windracers ULTRA autonomous aircraft conducted the inaugural test of the Midwest UAS Test Site of Indiana on Oct. 29 at Terre Haute Regional Airport. The test site partners with Purdue University, the Indiana National Guard, and the Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division to create a 224-mile-long and 15-mile-wide drone corridor.

stories.title: A $4 million missile to stop a $35,000 drone: What the Iran war’s weapons cost the US and its allies
stories.summary: The Pentagon estimated the war cost at least $47.1 billion through Oct. 16, including $29 billion to replace munitions. U.S. allies in the Persian Gulf fired hundreds of $4 million Patriot missiles to stop Shahed drones costing $20,000 to $50,000 apiece.

stories.title: Indian Railways launches new daily train between Kanpur and Delhi; check route and details
stories.summary: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the new Kanpur Express on Monday, a daily service covering 428 km between Kanpur Central and Anand Vihar Terminal in Delhi. The train features 22 Linke Hofmann Busch coaches and stops at industrial hubs including Phaphund, Etawah, Tundla, Hathras, Aligarh, Khurja, Dadri, and Ghaziabad.

stories.title: 3D-printing-based production: JATEC launches project for Ukraine's unmanned systems
Kelluu unveils a passive radar for a new era
stories.summary: Kelluu developed HALO airships, which function as airborne passive radars that detect targets by receiving radio, TV, and mobile network signals without transmitting. The company states that HALO airships can more than double the range of traditional ground-based passive radars and cost up to 180 times less per hour in the air than crewed radar aircraft. Kelluu will present HALO at NATO Edge 26 in İzmir, Türkiye, on 17–19 November, and is engaging with five partner nations for a closed pilot starting at the beginning of 2027.

stories.title: Tesla goes all-in on the Cybercab with upcoming €3B Berlin Gigafactory expansion
stories.summary: Tesla announced Monday that it will spend €3 billion ($3.3 billion) to expand its Berlin gigafactory in Grünheide, with plans to begin building Cybercabs there in 2029. Construction is expected to begin in the first half of 2027, and the new building will be capable of producing up to 1 million vehicles per year.

also.title: Tesla Wants to Build 1 Million Cybercabs in Europe. There’s Just One Problem.
Tesla commits €3 billion to Cybercab plant as EU robotaxi rules lag

stories.title: UK to trial ‘ghost radars’ to protect power plants and airfields from drone attack
stories.summary: The UK government will trial BAE Systems' passive radar technology next year to protect power plants and airfields from drone attacks. The system, which uses existing radio signals to detect drones without transmitting its own signal, is designed to be deployed from an SUV and could reach the market by mid-2027.

stories.title: U.S. Navy tests camera navigation for drones over jammed seas
stories.summary: The Naval Postgraduate School reported that a ScanEagle drone flew for six hours off Southern California without GPS, using Rhoman Aerospace's camera-based navigation system to stay on course. The system achieved under 0.5 percent drift versus distance, allowing the drone to hit waypoints near San Clemente Island with satellite navigation and ground links switched off.

stories.title: NATO operations in Black Sea continue as Romania investigates drone debris
stories.summary: Romania deployed naval explosive ordnance disposal teams Monday to investigate drone debris found 45 nautical miles east of Mangalia and in the Sfantu Gheorghe area. The operation follows a French Navy aircraft spotting two drifting drones on Sunday, with Bulgaria and Türkiye participating in Mine Counter-Measures Task Group operations from Nov. 6 to 18.

stories.title: The railway bridge in Wigan named as one of Britain's 'most bashed'
stories.summary: Network Rail named the Prescott Street bridge in Wigan as one of Britain's most struck structures, recording 12 incidents in 2025/26. The agency reported 1,706 total strikes nationwide, causing 185,319 minutes of delays and costing around £13.25m.

stories.title: Tesla Nearly Doubles Miami Robotaxi Service Area, Expands Into Downtown
stories.summary: Tesla nearly doubled its Miami Robotaxi service area to 59 square miles, expanding coverage into Downtown Miami, Brickell, and Biscayne Bay. The expansion follows the launch of 24/7 service in all eight unsupervised markets on November 12.

stories.title: Trump Claims U.S. Air Defenses Intercepted 99.99% of Iran’s Missile and Drone Attacks
stories.summary: President Donald Trump claimed on Truth Social that U.S. defenses neutralized 99.99% of Iran’s 8,000–9,000 drones and 2,000 missiles launched since February 28, stating only two drones and one missile penetrated defenses to kill U.S. personnel.

stories.title: Swarmer Closes Vataga Drone Deal, Adding FPV And Interceptor Hardware
stories.summary: Swarmer completed its acquisition of intellectual property from Ukrainian drone maker Vataga, adding FPV airframe designs and initiation electronics to its portfolio. Vataga CEO Maksym Melnyk and 14 research and development staff joined Swarmer, while Vataga continues operating as an independent manufacturer.

stories.title: FCC pushes to shut down DJI’s lawsuit over US drone ban
stories.summary: The FCC and the US Department of Justice (DOJ) renewed their push to have DJI’s lawsuit dismissed, arguing that the company must first wait for the FCC’s full Commission to act on its pending request for reconsideration before seeking judicial review.

stories.title: Eve and FlyBIS Sign Binding Deal for Up to 12 eVTOLs, Only Two Firm
stories.summary: Eve Air Mobility signed a binding agreement with FlyBIS for up to 12 eVTOL aircraft, with only two firm orders and ten purchase rights. The contract reduces a 2022 letter of intent for 40 aircraft, and Eve expects its first conforming prototype flight in the second half of 2027.

stories.title: AI Moves Into Aviation: FAA Rolls Out SMART Airspace Tool as Joby Completes Autonomous Cross-Country Flight
stories.summary: US transportation secretary Sean Duffy announced SMART, an AI-powered air-traffic management tool built by Air Space Intelligence, on 27 September. The FAA states the system is meant to help controllers by using predictive AI to head off scheduling snags, not to replace them.

stories.title: Two Drone Strikes Wipe Out Entire Russian Motorcycle Fleet Hidden in Woods, Video
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone operators from the 110th Separate Mechanized Brigade destroyed four Russian motorcycles and an all-terrain vehicle in two strikes on November 16. The unit released footage showing the vehicles, which Russian forces had concealed among trees and bushes, after the operators revisited a previously targeted position.

stories.title: DJI Matrice 4 Series gets new firmware update with regulatory changes
stories.summary: DJI released a firmware update for its Matrice 4E and Matrice 4T drones, bringing regulatory changes and bug fixes to the enterprise lineup. The update brings the aircraft to version 19.01.00.07 and the DJI RC Plus 2 Enterprise remote controller to version 19.01.00.08, while also updating compatible accessories and software.

stories.title: Petition for Exemption; Summary of Petition Received; Blue Vigil, LLC
stories.summary: The FAA published a summary of a petition seeking relief from specified requirements of Federal Aviation Regulations. The notice aims to improve public awareness and participation in the FAA's exemption process.

stories.title: Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; Modernization of FMVSS No. 108 To Accommodate ADS-Equipped Vehicles
stories.summary: NHTSA announced a 15-day extension of the public comment period for a proposed rulemaking to amend Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 108. The proposal, requested by the Alliance for Automotive Innovation, SAE International, and Gatik AI Inc., would distinguish how regulations apply to vehicles with and without manually operated driving controls.

stories.title: Northern Indiana Commuter Transportation District's Request To Amend Its Positive Train Control System
stories.summary: The Northern Indiana Commuter Transportation District submitted a request for amendment to its FRA-certified positive train control system on November 1, 2026. NICD intends to replace several Cisco Networking devices, involving Trains 35, 432, and 601 operating without PTC technology for approximately three hours.

stories.title: Union Minister reviews Ahmedabad station revamp, Bullet Train project and passenger movement plans
stories.summary: Union Minister of State for Railways and Jal Shakti, V Somanna, reviewed plans to improve connectivity between Ahmedabad's existing railway station and the under-construction Bullet Train station on November 15. He inspected redevelopment work at Ahmedabad Railway Station and the Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail station, discussing construction timelines and passenger movement arrangements with officials from the Railways, RLDA, and NHSRCL.

stories.title: Romania deploys naval teams to investigate drone debris in Black Sea
stories.summary: Romania is deploying naval explosive ordnance disposal teams to assess drone debris reported 45 nautical miles east of Mangalia and in the Sfantu Gheorghe area. The ministry said the investigation follows a French Navy aircraft report of two adrift drones and coincides with Mine Counter-Measures Task Group operations from Nov. 6-18.

also.title: Romania deploys naval teams to investigate Black Sea drone debris

stories.title: Volatus Has A Mirabel Factory. A UK Firm Makes Its First 100 Drones
stories.summary: Volatus Aerospace will have a UK-based company manufacture its first 100 reconnaissance drones for the Canadian Armed Forces, despite operating a 53,000-square-foot factory at Montréal-Mirabel International Airport. Chief executive Glen Lynch stated the company will invest in local manufacturing if the outsourced batch succeeds, with deliveries expected to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026.

stories.title: A.P. govt. approves Robotics and Physical AI Policy 2026–36 aimed at total ecosystem for State
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government approved the Robotics and Physical AI Policy 2026–36 on Monday to develop an end-to-end robotics and physical AI ecosystem in the State. The policy covers components, robot platforms, system integration, R & D, talent development, and adoption.

stories.title: Cathie Wood Buys Archer, Down More Than 40% in 2026. Is Joby the Better Air Taxi Bet?
stories.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest added to Archer Aviation on Nov. 12, 2026, after the stock fell 42% year-to-date. Ark held 33,822,169 Archer shares as of Sept. 30, 2026, while Archer lost $274.6 million in the third quarter on $5.1 million in revenue.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drones Have Cut Russian Refining by 55% – Zelensky
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukrainian drones have disabled more than 55% of Russia's oil refining capacity. The International Energy Agency assessment stated that Ukrainian drones have hit 27 of 32 major oil refineries within Russia's borders.

stories.title: Mobilicom Establishes U.S. Manufacturing for Cybersecure Drone Datalinks
stories.summary: Mobilicom established its first U.S. manufacturing operations in Phoenix, Arizona, through a domestic defense and aerospace manufacturing partner. Initial production of its cybersecure datalink products is expected by year-end 2026.

stories.title: Baton Rouge Residents Counted 18 Amazon Drone Overflights in 21 Minutes - Exposing Growing Clash Over Noise, Privacy, and Federal Airspace Rules
stories.summary: Baton Rouge residents logged 18 Amazon drone overflights in 21 minutes, but local officials lack authority to intervene as long as Amazon operates within FAA parameters. Amazon rerouted approximately 70% of flights away from one heavily affected neighborhood after sustained complaints.

stories.title: Driverless Waymo Cars May Be Coming To Chicago
stories.summary: The Illinois legislative session will convene in January with a proposal on the docket to allow driverless robotaxis in larger Illinois counties, namely Cook. The bill would launch an AV (autonomous vehicle) pilot to test how the cars would operate in the state.

stories.title: Tesla on Autopilot/FSD hit an overturned truck at 71 mph, killing 3
stories.summary: Tesla filed a federal report stating Autopilot or “Full Self-Driving” was “Verified Engaged” at 71 mph when a 2023 Model 3 hit an overturned truck on I-75 near Naples, Florida, killing three people. The company redacted the crash narrative and software version as “confidential business information.”

stories.title: Iarnród Éireann publishes preferred route for Navan railway
stories.summary: Iarnród Éireann published its preferred alignment for a 34 km railway to integrate Navan into the Dublin region’s DART commuter network.

stories.title: 12 crew members rescued after cargo ship capsizes off Bulgaria following suspected drone strike
stories.summary: Maritime authorities rescued all 12 crew members from the Somali-flagged Betul 8 after it capsized off the coast of Bulgaria in the Black Sea on Monday following a suspected drone strike. The vessel, which was carrying almost 3,000 tonnes of bulk wheat from Tulcea in Romania to Egypt, was reported sinking at around 9:15 am in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone.

stories.title: America Has a Drone Problem. Can Its Defenses Keep Up?
stories.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration recorded 601 drone sightings near U.S. airports between April and June 2026, nearly double the 320 reported in the preceding quarter. On November 9, 2026, several U.S. federal agencies announced an expanded interagency initiative to coordinate counter-unmanned aircraft operations and evaluate technologies for protecting aviation and national security.

stories.title: More Oslo metro trains ordered
stories.summary: Oslo public transport operator Sporveien increased its order for CAF M4000 metro trainsets.

stories.title: JTEKT on human-centred factory automation and scaling robotics
Draganfly Plans Local Drone Manufacturing Venture in the Philippines
stories.summary: Canadian drone manufacturer Draganfly signed an agreement with Prime Strategic Holdings, Inc., to develop local drone manufacturing capabilities in the Philippines. The proposed joint venture aims to establish domestic manufacturing, maintenance, and technical support for unmanned systems, combining Draganfly’s engineering with Philippine industrial resources.

stories.title: Inside Canada's Northern drone ambitions
stories.summary: Canada announced the acquisition of 11 General Atomics MQ-9B SkyGuardian aircraft and six ground control stations in December 2023. National Defence plans first delivery in early 2028, with full operational capability expected within fiscal years 2030-31 and 2032-33.

stories.title: Robotics Adoption Hub meet at UWTSD to drive innovation for Welsh businesses
stories.summary: The University of Wales Trinity Saint David (UWTSD) hosted partners from the Robotics Adoption Hub – South Wales at its SA1 Waterfront campus in Swansea for a strategic planning event. Funded by Innovate UK, the Hub will provide Welsh businesses with access to robotics demonstrations, specialist advice, and testing environments to support the adoption of automation technologies.

stories.title: The Ukrainian Sokil UAV can now stay airborne for up to four hours
stories.summary: The Ukrainian company Vyriy Industries has opened orders for the upgraded Sokil reconnaissance drone, which will be available for purchase starting November 12. The upgrades affect flight performance, the navigation system, and camera functionality.

stories.title: Afternoon analysis: Is China’s drone carrier nearing commissioning?
stories.summary: The Chinese navy announced the GJ-21 stealth drone's first successful take-off and landing aboard the Sichuan, its first Type 076 amphibious assault ship. The Sichuan, with a displacement of more than 40,000 tonnes, is expected to enter service before the end of 2026.

stories.title: Xtremis Awarded U.S. Army AUGUR SHIELD Contract to Advance Next-Generation Counter-UAS Capabilities
stories.summary: Xtremis was awarded a contract by the U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command Army Research Laboratory to develop AI-driven spectrum monitoring and multi-domain sensor capabilities under the AUGUR SHIELD initiative. The multi-year effort aims to detect and mitigate unmanned aerial system threats that use frequency-agile communications to evade traditional radio frequency-based sensor systems.

also.title: Xtremis Wins Army AUGUR SHIELD Work On Adaptive Counter-Drone Sensing

stories.title: Beijing Drone Ownership Ban Takes Effect, Police Held Two For Flying
stories.summary: Beijing’s ban on owning or storing a drone took effect on Sunday, November 15, across the entire municipality. Keeping an aircraft or one of its listed core components at home now brings confiscation, and police may add a fine of 500 to 5,000 yuan for an individual.

stories.title: Draganfly Signs Exclusive Agreement with Prime Strategic Holdings to Establish Philippine Drone and Autonomous Systems Capability
stories.summary: Draganfly Inc. signed an exclusive agreement with Prime Strategic Holdings, Inc. to establish a joint venture for local manufacturing of drones and autonomous systems in the Philippines. The partnership aims to reduce reliance on foreign imports and support disaster response, agriculture, and critical infrastructure monitoring.

stories.title: Mercedes’ Hands-Free Driving Assist Tackled San Fran’s Steepest Streets, Cyclists, Traffic. Here’s How It Went
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz allows California drivers to use MB Drive Assist Pro and Hands-Free Highway Assist for point-to-point driving at speeds up to 85 mph. The system uses 27 sensing components and is available on eligible 2027 models, with 2028 models to follow.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz takes a big leap forward with its self-driving plans
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz announced its MB.DRIVE assistance technology, which allows drivers to remove their hands from the steering wheel at speeds up to 130km/h on motorways. The system begins rolling out in Germany and the United States from late 2026, with more advanced point-to-point driving capabilities arriving in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Autonomous Ground Systems and Irregular Warfare: A Conversation with Pat Acox of Forterra
stories.summary: Pat Acox, Vice President for Autonomous Systems at Forterra, discussed how autonomous ground vehicles support military resupply, casualty evacuation, and partner forces in irregular warfare. He noted that commercial technology is rapidly closing the performance gap with exquisite platforms, allowing for rapid innovation and adaptation in wartime environments.

stories.title: AIR Sends First Autonomous Cargo eVTOL to U.S. Headquarters for Flight Demonstrations
stories.summary: AIR VEV shipped its first AIR 120D autonomous cargo aircraft to its Florida headquarters for flight demonstrations. The aircraft carries approximately 550 pounds of payload in a 70-cubic-foot cargo bay and operates without an onboard pilot.

also.title: AIR Sends Cargo Drone to Florida
AIR Ships First 120D Autonomous Cargo eVTOL To Florida For Flights
Runway-free autonomous cargo aircraft carries 550 pounds without a pilot onboard
AIR Brings Autonomous Cargo Aircraft to Florida for Flight Demonstrations

stories.title: Velo3D Selected for U.S. Defense Award with Potential Value of Up to $10 Million for UAS Warhead and Lethal Payload Systems
stories.summary: Velo3D was selected by DEVCOM Armaments Center for an award with a potential value of up to $10 million to develop UAS warheads and lethal payload systems using metal additive manufacturing. The program will focus on Inconel 718 and a second Government-directed alloy, progressing through process development, hardware production, and testing.

stories.title: Modernising Rail Systems: Technology takes centre stage in signalling, operations and maintenance
stories.summary: Indian Railways has adopted Kavach as its national automatic train protection system, with about 44,000 route km of high-density routes identified as a major priority for deployment. The network spans roughly 78,000 route km, and current deployment remains below 5 per cent of the overall network.

stories.title: Ukraine drone maker says it wouldn't exist with Western bureaucracy
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone maker TechEx told Business Insider it would not exist if it had to adhere to strict Western-style weapons regulations, warning that cutting red tape is key to keeping pace in modern warfare. The company, which works with more than 100 units, stated that if Russia attacks Europe, there will be no time for bureaucracy or multi-level approvals.

stories.title: Ukrainian PM anticipates 12-fold increase in Russian jet-powered drone attacks in November
stories.summary: Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi stated that Russia could launch up to 6,500 jet-powered drones against Ukraine in November, a 12-fold increase from the 530 launched in August. He noted that Russian forces are also using guided aerial bombs, missiles, and tens of thousands of fibre-optic FPV drones, while the government focuses on safeguarding energy facilities and repairing power lines.

stories.title: Mullin Says DHS Drone Defense Has Holes, Counts 2,000 At World Cup
stories.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said on Sunday that federal teams encountered more than 2,000 drones during the FIFA World Cup, confiscating 700 and making multiple arrests. He acknowledged holes in the department's ability to bring down real threats, noting that physically downing a drone creates airspace issues for the FAA.

stories.title: Contra-Drone has handed over eight pick-up trucks equipped with electronic warfare systems to units of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and the National Guard of Ukraine
stories.summary: Contra Drone handed over eight vehicles fitted with «8 Ultra» electronic warfare systems and Sense-3 detectors to units of the Ukrainian Armed Forces and the National Guard of Ukraine. The equipment is intended for units carrying out missions on the front line to counter threats from drones.

stories.title: Blueberry grower in Australia trials driverless tractors and autonomous harvesting
stories.summary: Western Berry, a blueberry grower 100 kilometres north of Perth, Australia, is trialling driverless tractors for spraying, weed control, and transport to address labor shortages. The 120-hectare operation expects to harvest just under 1,500 tons this year, with mechanical harvesting costing approximately A$0.50 per kg compared with A$6 for manual labor.

stories.title: Estonia to close border with Russia after arson attack on local drone maker
stories.summary: Estonia will close its road border crossings with Russia beginning on Dec. 1, following an attempted arson attack on drone maker Threod Systems in Viimsi. Estonian officials stated the attack was carried out at the behest of the GRU, Russia’s military intelligence service, and that closing the borders will reduce Russia’s ability to conduct hostile activities.

stories.title: Camp Lejeune Turns Military Drones Into Tools for Firefighters and First Responders
stories.summary: Camp Lejeune deployed about a dozen Skydio X2D drones to detect fires and assess hazards across its nearly 250-square-mile installation. The base plans to expand drone use to building interiors with Teledyne FLIR Black Hornet 3 units and to support water safety responses.

stories.title: MatrixSpace Portable C-UAS Detection Solutions Now Available on JIATF 401 C-UAS Marketplace
stories.summary: MatrixSpace's portable counter-UAS solutions are now available on the Department of War's Joint Interagency Task Force 401 C-UAS Marketplace. The listing enables U.S. federal procurement offices, military commands, and pre-cleared allied defense ministries to access the technology through rapid acquisition pathways.

also.title: MatrixSpace Counter-Drone Radar Joins The Pentagon's C-UAS Marketplace

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone manufacturing expands in the UK
stories.summary: The National Wealth Fund invested £113 million in UFORCE to expand its UK engineering, training, and production teams. The company will source more than 70% of each UK-built boat's content from British suppliers, creating hundreds of high-skilled jobs.

stories.title: GXO and Apptronik plan rollout of up to 1,000 humanoid robots
stories.summary: GXO Logistics signed an agreement with Apptronik to expand joint trials of Apollo humanoid robots in live warehouse operations. Subject to meeting agreed performance, safety, and operational KPIs, the companies intend to progress toward a global rollout of up to 1,000 Apollo robots over the next four years, with initial deployment in North America in late 2027.

stories.title: MicroVision Lidar Powers Commercial Driverless Trucking at Scale with Kodiak AI
stories.summary: MicroVision announced a partnership with Kodiak AI to integrate its IRIS long-range lidar into Kodiak's sixth-generation autonomous platform. Kodiak plans to launch unsupervised driverless long-haul commercial service by the end of 2026 and scale deployments throughout 2027.

stories.title: Wing Drone Nest Needs No Trustee Vote in Ohio: 'It's Coming'
stories.summary: Wing does not need a vote of Union Township’s trustees to put a drone nest at the Eastgate Walmart east of Cincinnati. The township’s recording of the board’s November 10 meeting shows chair Joe Dills asking whether the service was already legal and being told it would be permitted along with the store’s approved use.

stories.title: Royal Air Force says Protector RG1 uncrewed aircraft tracked a Russian vessel for more than 10 hours
stories.summary: A Royal Air Force Protector RG1 tracked a Russian vessel for more than 10 hours in October, gathering intelligence while working alongside the Royal Navy’s HMS Tyne. The RAF says Protector has joined its P-8A Poseidon aircraft in monitoring waters around the British Isles following its first operational mission over UK waters.

stories.title: Italian Firm Tekne Bids for US Army’s Electronic Warfare, Drone Defense Projects
stories.summary: Italian defense firm Tekne submitted two technical white papers to the US Army’s Spectrum Enabled Warfare xTech competition and a separate response to its C-UAS Fly Away Kit competition. The company, which is 70-percent-owned by US-based NUBURU, seeks to expand its presence in the American defense market.

stories.title: Intelic connects Saab airborne radar into C-UAS command and control system “within minutes”
stories.summary: Intelic integrated its NEXUS command-and-control platform with Saab’s Giraffe 1X radar in 30 minutes during a field test at a military base in the Netherlands. The combined system detects aerial targets, filters out birds, and allows commanders to initiate interception responses directly through the NEXUS interface.

stories.title: Siemens Delivers Final Desiro ML Train to ÖBB
stories.summary: Siemens handed over the 294th and final Desiro ML train to ÖBB, completing a major procurement programme. All 294 trains, comprising 898 rail carriages, will operate throughout Austria in configurations ranging from 75 to 101 metres in length.

stories.title: Tesla takes an early step for bringing the Cybercab to the masses
stories.summary: Tesla announced it is inviting select customers to purchase its Cybercab for personal use at an estimated price of $29,990 before taxes, with initial deliveries projected for as early as December. Buyers must pay a mandatory $299 monthly Autonomy Subscription, and privately owned vehicles are restricted to personal use within supported robotaxi service areas.

also.title: Tesla Cybercab Now Open To Select Customers For $29,990
Tesla Cybercab Now Available to Pre-Order for Personal Use With a $299 Monthly Fee

stories.title: The ticket into the game of transformation: PRASA takes rail ticketing digital
stories.summary: PRASA has invested in modernizing its ticketing systems to introduce cashless payments and digital validation cards. Train and bus commuters will be able to buy tickets through four channels: WhatsApp, the PRASA mobile app, an e-commerce platform, and handheld point of sale (POS) devices.

stories.title: Fresh GJ-11 footage gives a glimpse of weapon bay on China’s next-gen drone
stories.summary: China released new images of its GJ-11 stealth combat drone on Monday, showing its internal weapon bay and shielded jet nozzle. The footage, aired by state broadcaster CCTV, highlights the drone's ability to coordinate with manned aircraft and conduct forward reconnaissance. The GJ-11 entered operational service no later than 2025 and has been tested at a desert facility in northwestern China.

stories.title: Duke Robotics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
stories.summary: Duke Robotics reported third-quarter revenue increased 38% year-over-year and announced a strategic collaboration with CRONOS to expand its IC Drone platform into Greece. The company identified potential large-scale projects in Greece representing tens of millions of euros in aggregate project activity over several years, with cash resources expected to support operations into 2028.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Could Match Waymo’s U.S. Miles in 2027, JPMorgan Says
stories.summary: JPMorgan said Tesla's robotaxi network could match Waymo's U.S. autonomous mileage in the second half of 2027 with an active fleet of about 18,000 vehicles, while maintaining a 'Neutral' rating and $430 price target on the stock.

stories.title: Greece Orders More V-BAT Drones for Aegean Surveillance
stories.summary: The NATO Support and Procurement Agency placed an order for additional Shield AI V-BAT drones for the Hellenic Armed Forces to support intelligence and surveillance missions across the Aegean. The company did not disclose the number of aircraft or the contract value, but the procurement adds to Greece’s existing fleet under the Uncrewed Aerial Systems Support Partnership.

stories.title: Airservices Australia launches Flight Information Management System services
stories.summary: Airservices Australia launched its Flight Information Management System (FIMS), a national platform allowing approved UTM service suppliers to deliver digital services to drone operators. The first group of approved suppliers, AvSoft, OneSky Systems, and Yarra Drones, are beginning to deliver FIMS-enabled services, with a second group expected to commence integration activities soon.

stories.title: Delivery drones are coming. For some with PTSD, that's a terrifying prospect.
stories.summary: Amazon announced plans to expand its Prime Air delivery drone program to “nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of 2026.” The expansion suggests flying robots dropping payloads onto suburban lawns will soon be commonplace, potentially triggering anxiety for people with post-traumatic stress disorder or other anxiety-related disorders.

stories.title: Zoox robotaxis are now on the Uber app in Las Vegas
stories.summary: Zoox robotaxis are officially available through the Uber app in Las Vegas, marking the Amazon-owned autonomous vehicle company’s first partnership with a third-party ride-hailing platform. Customers requesting an UberX, Uber Comfort, Uber Electric, Uber Comfort Electric, or Wait & Save ride may be matched with one of Zoox’s custom-built robotaxis.

stories.summary: General Atomics proposed integrating German and European mission systems into its Gambit combat drones for the Luftwaffe, with potential production in Bavaria. The company targets European mission-equipped Gambit 6 deliveries in 2029, though no German procurement contract or delivery schedule has been announced.

SkyGrid and MIT Lincoln Laboratory Extend Low-Altitude Weather Forecasting Research
stories.summary: SkyGrid and MIT Lincoln Laboratory extended their research partnership to develop high-resolution weather forecasting systems for advanced air mobility, with the next phase running until July 2027. The collaboration aims to improve forecasts for low-altitude operations, including autonomous cargo flights and passenger-carrying electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft.

stories.title: Russia’s Barometer “develops wheeled barrier to protect airfields from drone attacks” – TASS
stories.summary: Russia’s Barometer patented a wheeled barrier designed to shield airfields from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) attacks. The utility model features a frame with protective modules containing three to four metal plates, allowing the barrier to function in two positions and connect into a continuous line of defence.

stories.title: Ireland uses Israeli anti-drone systems to protect EU leaders despite government boycott pledge
stories.summary: An Garda Síochána purchased military-grade anti-drone jammers from Tel Aviv-based Sentrycs to defend EU Presidency events, despite Dublin's government pledge not to buy Israeli technology. The equipment was sourced through a US supplier and mounted on building roofs to prevent drones from flying over events during Ireland's presidency from July 1 until December 31.

also.title: Ireland's police turn to Israeli anti-drone technology despite government boycott pledge

stories.title: Saab to Equip Royal Navy Drone Boats With Sea Giraffe Radars
stories.summary: The Royal Navy awarded Saab a 15-million-pound ($20 million) contract to integrate Sea Giraffe 1X radar systems onto Kraken Technology’s K3 Scout uncrewed surface vessels. The Royal Navy acquired 20 K3 Scout USVs earlier this year as testbeds for future operations.

stories.title: Putin Humiliated as His Crown Jewel Is Hit Amid Record Drone Blitz
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck the $3.6 billion Kerch Bridge, closing the 12-mile crossing to traffic and delaying passenger trains. Sergei Aksyonov, the Kremlin-installed leader of Crimea, said restrictions would remain in place until at least midday while officials assess the damage.

stories.title: UK drone roll-out advances with detect-and-avoid and delivery testing
stories.summary: The UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) authorized Amazon's Prime Air to expand drone deliveries in Darlington, increasing eligible households from around 600 to roughly 8,000. This approval grants the world's first SAIL 4 operating authorisation, allowing flights over more densely populated communities.

stories.title: Russia Claims Ukraine Launched Largest Drone Assault of the War With Over 2,000 UAVs
stories.summary: Russia’s Defense Ministry claimed its air defense systems intercepted 2,049 Ukrainian drones, four Flamingo cruise missiles, and seven guided aerial bombs within 24 hours, marking what Moscow describes as the largest Ukrainian drone attack since the beginning of Russia’s full-scale invasion.

stories.title: An Eric Trump-backed military robot startup missed payroll on October 30; its CEO had borrowed $4.6 million from the company to purchase a California home
stories.summary: Foundation, a San Francisco military robot startup backed by Eric Trump, missed its October 30 payroll and has not paid some employees nearly two weeks later. The company’s CEO, Sankaet Pathak, borrowed $4.6 million from the business in 2025 to purchase a home in Sausalito, California, while Foundation seeks a new funding round at a reported $3 billion valuation.

stories.title: AI Security Technology Developed to Detect Autonomous Vehicle Hacks With 99.87% Accuracy
stories.summary: Sookmyung Women's University announced that a research team led by Professor Jung Seong-hun and undergraduate student Kim Ji-su developed an AI technology called “X-SPUR” that detects cyberattacks on in-vehicle communication networks with 99.87% accuracy. The system explains the basis for its decisions by analyzing normal communication data, and the findings were published in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics.

stories.title: Ghana, DRC, and other African countries feature in new report linking 50 African women to Russia's attack drone industry used to fight Ukraine
stories.summary: A new report links Ghana and the Democratic Republic of Congo to a deal with a Russian defense company producing attack drones. The investigation identifies roughly 50 African women working at the Alabuga Special Economic Zone, where they are drawn into the production of Geran-series attack drones used by the Russian military.

also.title: Russia’s Alabuga Factory Promises Opportunity to African Women—But the Jobs Support Shahed Drone Production

stories.title: The Role of Airborne Early Warning & Control Platforms in One-Way-Attack Drone Defense
stories.summary: Iran launched an estimated 4,400 Shahed-family one-way-attack drones against Israel and U.S. military installations between February 28th and early April, with the U.A.E. alone targeted by 2,210 drones. The conflict highlighted the critical role of airborne early warning & control platforms, such as the U.S. Navy’s E-2D Hawkeye II, in detecting low-flying drones that ground-based radars struggle to track.

stories.title: Zelensky Urges Musk, US To Lift Starshield Speed Restrictions Affecting Ukraine’s Drone Defences
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky urged Elon Musk and the United States government to lift speed restrictions on the Starshield satellite internet service, stating the limits prevent interceptor drones from catching Russian jet-powered drones at 161km/h (100mph). Zelensky said the restrictions affect defense of energy infrastructure ahead of winter and carry political implications regarding occupied territories.

stories.title: Pentagon Security Scare Exposed After French Tourist Allegedly Flies Drone Over Military Headquarters, Pete Hegseth Vows to Protect U.S. Airspace
stories.summary: A French tourist faces federal criminal allegations for allegedly flying a DJI Mini 3 drone over the Pentagon on October 29, 2026, without an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate or authorization for restricted airspace. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth vowed to protect U.S. airspace as federal agencies announced new counter-drone coordination measures on November 9.

stories.title: A $3,000 Drone Against A Million-Dollar Missile: How Modern Warfare Is Changing
stories.summary: Chief of Defence Staff General NS Raja Subramani warned at the ANI National Security Summit 3.0 in New Delhi that using a million-dollar missile to counter a $2,500 or $3,000 drone creates unsustainable economic imbalances. He identified three shifts in modern warfare: changing cost calculations, competition for AI and critical minerals, and the expansion of battlefields across entire national territories.

stories.title: Drone Federation India Proposes 22 Measures to Boost Domestic Drone Component Manufacturing, Reduce Import Dependence
stories.summary: The Drone Federation India released a whitepaper with 22 policy recommendations to strengthen domestic drone component manufacturing and reduce import dependence. The document, titled ‘Making the Swadeshi Switch’, was presented at the Bharat Drone Stack Conference 2026 in Bengaluru and includes proposals for Indian-content requirements and targeted incentives.

stories.title: Türkiye’s ASELSAN EJDERHA Electromagnetic Weapon Marks New Era After Disabling 51 Drones in Seconds
stories.summary: ASELSAN demonstrated its EJDERHA high-power electromagnetic system neutralizing 51 drones within seconds at the Gölbek Firing and Test Center. The system used a single command to disable the targets without firing missiles or consuming ammunition.

stories.title: Ukraine launches biggest drone attack on Russia since war began
stories.summary: Ukraine launched its biggest overnight drone attack on Russia since the full-scale war began in 2022, with Moscow saying its air defense forces brought down 1,336 Ukrainian drones across 16 regions. That surpasses a previous record of 1,254 drones registered on October 29.

stories.title: Nokia to develop ISAC technology for US military drone detection project
stories.summary: Nokia Federal Solutions won a US Department of War contract to develop integrated sensing and communications technology for the RAPID project. The system uses 5G and 6G networks to detect drone threats, partnering with Texas Tech University and DeepSig.

stories.title: ROBOTERA Launches XHAND 1 Pro-U, Featured in NVIDIA's GR00T 2 DexUMI Demonstration
Grand Central seeks approval for new Manchester to London St Pancras rail service
Estonian drone company targeted in sabotage attempt as part of ‘Russia’s hybrid war against Europe’: Prime Minister Michal
stories.summary: Estonian authorities accused Russian intelligence of orchestrating a Nov. 14 sabotage attempt targeting drone manufacturer Threod Systems, which Prime Minister Kristen Michal described as part of a broader hybrid war against Europe. The Estonian Foreign Ministry announced that all Estonian-Russian border crossing points would close as of Dec. 1, while the Kremlin stated it is verifying the allegations.

stories.title: Industry Minister inspects 5 factories specializing in industrial robotics, automation systems
stories.summary: Egypt's Industry Minister Khaled Hashem inspected five factories in the Third Settlement Industrial Zone to review production operations and expansion plans. The tour included Aria Technologies, which produces over 100 industrial robots annually with a 40% local component ratio, and Jeans Car for Industry, which operates a specialized vehicle upholstery training school.

stories.title: NHSRCL to energise Surat-Bilimora bullet train section with 25,000 volts from 20th November
stories.summary: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited will begin energising the Surat-Bilimora elevated section with 25,000 volts from 20th November 2026. This step supports the goal of opening the 50-km stretch by 2027, with the full Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor scheduled to open by 2029.

stories.title: IRGC Navy captures US drone intact over Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolution Guards Corps Navy captured a US MQM-170 drone intact south of Qeshm Island after taking control of its flight guidance system. The drone had been operating in the area to track and identify air defence and electronic warfare systems.

stories.title: Existing seismic networks can record sonic booms from supersonic flights
stories.summary: Penn State researchers identified and mapped sonic booms from supersonic flights using existing seismometer networks in Southern California. The study, published in the Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, found that up to 26 seismometers recorded secondary boom signals covering approximately 11,600 square miles.

stories.title: NJ Transit board authorizes $65M to improve Hudson-Bergen light rail
stories.summary: NJ Transit’s board of directors authorized $65.6 million for capital improvements on the Hudson-Bergen Light Rail system, the first allocation of a planned $250 million investment over the next five years. The funds will support elevator upgrades at the 8th Street, 9th Street and Bergenline Avenue stations, overhauls of light rail vehicles and right-of-way improvements.

More than 2,200 km of anti-drone protection has been installed along Ukraine’s frontline roads — Ministry of Defence
stories.summary: The State Special Transport Service installed anti-drone nets on more than 2,200 km of Ukraine’s frontline roads since April 2025. The Ministry of Defense stated the work is ongoing to protect vehicles from Russian drone strikes and maintain vital logistics routes.

stories.title: Elite Robots Launches CE-Compliant ELITEMISSION Mobile Manipulators Globally
stories.summary: Elite Robots launched its CE-compliant ELITEMISSION mobile manipulators globally, pairing collaborative robotic arms with autonomous mobile platforms to navigate between workstations. The systems support machine loading, precision component handling, and material transfer across automotive, electronics, semiconductor, and new energy sectors.

stories.title: Taiwan’s N700ST train completes mainline test
stories.summary: Taiwan High Speed Rail found eight employees falsified track inspection records.

stories.title: Saronic Contracted to Build Autonomous Low Profile Vessel (ALPV)
stories.summary: Saronic Technologies was awarded a prototype Other Transaction agreement by the Defense Innovation Unit to deliver an Autonomous Low Profile Vessel for U.S. Marine Corps maritime resupply. The vessel is designed for long-range, low-signature autonomous logistics, incorporating technology from over 350,000 nautical miles of prior operations.

stories.title: Ukrainian servicemen from the special police unit Hyzhak prepare a Gara, a Ukrainian multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with AI elements, in the Donetsk region of Ukraine in May. UN diplomats will meet next week in Switzerland to discuss AI use in war.
stories.summary: The UN prepares to discuss autonomous weapons this week, as insiders say hopes of meaningful, binding regulations around AI in warfare are slim and time may be running out.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Armed Sea Drone Wins Nighttime Battle Against Russian Naval Drone, Video
stories.summary: The Ukrainian Navy reported on November 16 that a Sargan 3000 unmanned surface vessel destroyed a Russian naval drone using its automated gun turret during a nighttime engagement in difficult weather conditions. The Navy did not specify the exact location or date of the operation, noting that operators identified the target despite limited visibility.

stories.title: Delhi-Patna Bullet Train Route: Five Stations Proposed in Bihar, Including Katihar
stories.summary: A proposed 1,500-km Delhi-Guwahati high-speed rail corridor will connect Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and Assam, with five stations in Bihar including Buxar, Patna, Begusarai, Khagaria, and Katihar. The Delhi-Patna journey is projected to take approximately 4 hours and 41 minutes, down from the current 11 to 14 hours, using Japanese Shinkansen technology at speeds up to 320 kmph.

stories.title: Hyundai Motor to standardize sensors across Kia, 42dot and Motional… Integrating autonomous driving data

stories.title: Cryptographic Anchoring Catches Post Hoc Tampering in Autonomous Robot
stories.summary: Researchers Tan Gürpinar and Mehmet Akif Gulum demonstrated a lightweight cryptographic framework that achieves one hundred percent post hoc tamper detection for autonomous multi-agent robotic decision logs by anchoring compact Merkle roots to a public blockchain ledger. Published in Frontiers in Blockchain, the peer-reviewed study evaluates the architecture across twelve adversarial attack classes, with every attempted modification identified against on-chain commitments across twelve thousand experimental trials and zero false positives in one thousand honest simulation runs.
